subject: Post-call: Novapay pricing & next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Novapay pricing & next steps

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good conversation. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can align on unit economics and procurement.

Key takeaways (please correct me if anything is off):
- Usage profile: ~2.5M requests / month; avg ~180 tokens per request (range: 80–400).
- Estimated monthly tokens: ~450M tokens / month (2.5M * 180).
- Peak: short bursts up to ~350 RPS during nightly batch jobs.
- Current target budget range you mentioned: roughly $800 – $1,200 per 1M tokens.
- Procurement note: you expect PO-based billing and a 30–60 day approval window.

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Confirm committed monthly volume (and whether Novapay is comfortable committing to a 12‑month term for a deeper discount).
2) Confirm procurement contact for invoicing/contract (we'll send an initial SOW + invoice estimate once terms are agreed).
3) Are there any compliance or data-retention notes we should surface to the legal team now?

Attached: redwood-pricing-calculator-v3.xlsx (pricing calculator) and a quick invoice estimate PDF I put together (.pdf contains one-page monthly & annual estimates).

Suggested next step: 30-minute follow-up next week to walk through the pricing calculator and lock the $/1M target and billing cadence. I have availability Tue/Wed morning PST.

If that all looks right, I’ll loop in Marissa (finance) to confirm invoicing cadence and send a formal estimate.

Best,
Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 555-1212

Attachments:
- redwood-pricing-calculator-v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
- novapay-invoice-estimate-20271208.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Samir Patel <samir@novapay.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Novapay pricing & next steps

On Wed, Dec 8, 2027 at 9:12 AM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the call earlier — good conversation. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can align on unit economics and procurement.

Thanks Sean — that recap matches my notes. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Committed volume: we can commit to 400M tokens/month for a 12-month term with seasonal +/-20% variability; there’s a runway to scale to 600M in Q3 if the pilot goes well.
- Procurement: please include our procurement mailbox (procurement@novapay.com) on all formal estimates.
- Budget: leadership is targeting ~$900 / 1M tokens as the internal target — strong preference for below $1,000 / 1M.

Questions:
1) What level of discount do you offer for a 12-month commit at 400M/mo vs. pay-as-you-go?
2) Can you show a worked example (monthly invoice) at $900/1M and at a discounted $700/1M so finance can see delta?
3) Is invoicing monthly with net30 acceptable? Any minimum invoice amounts?

Happy to take a follow-up demo on the sheet — Tue/Wed mornings next week work here too.

Thanks,
Samir
Director, Platform Engineering
Novapay
samir@novapay.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2027 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Novapay pricing & next steps

Samir — great, thanks for the quick confirm. Below is a concise worked example and the primary levers that move the unit economics. I also updated the attached pricing calculator (linked) with the 400M commit scenario.

Worked examples (monthly) — baseline 450M tokens/month estimate vs confirmed 400M commit:
- Scenario A (no commit, list rate): list $1,200 / 1M tokens => 450 * $1,200 = $540,000 / month
- Scenario B (400M/mo 12‑month commit): negotiated price options we can offer:
  • Standard commit offer: $900 / 1M tokens => 400 * $900 = $360,000 / month
  • Aggressive commit (12 mo + 24% prepayment/volume guarantee): $700 / 1M tokens => 400 * $700 = $280,000 / month

Key savings breakdown (how Redwood arrives at unit economics):
- Model execution cost (GPU + kernels): ~35–45% of list price at scale, varies by sequence length and quantization profile.
- Caching & batching savings: for steady-state traffic we model ~12–18% effective token savings (prefix KV + repeated prompts).
- Commitment discount: applied on top of list; deeper discounts require term/volume guarantees.

Notes / asks for procurement:
- We can invoice monthly (Net30) — Marissa, can you confirm minimum invoice threshold?
- I’ll send a formal one-page invoice estimate (attached PDF) and a link to the editable calc for finance to poke at: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1A2b3C-pricing-calc

Next steps (proposed):
1) Sean + Samir + Marissa — 30-min call next Tue 2027-12-14 9:30AM PST to review the sheet and lock price.
2) After agreement, we’ll produce an SOW + invoice estimate and route to procurement@novapay.com for PO.
3) If Novapay signs a 12-mo commit, we’ll issue a contract with the agreed committed rate and monthly invoicing.

Marissa — looping you in to confirm invoicing cadence and to take care of the actual invoice template/PO flow.

Samir — attaching the two artifacts again for convenience: redwood-pricing-calculator-v3.xlsx and novapay-invoice-estimate-20271208.pdf. I’ll also paste the one-page PDF summary into the follow-up meeting invite.

Best,
Sean
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

Attachments:
- redwood-pricing-calculator-v3.xlsx (updated with 400M commit scenarios)
- novapay-invoice-estimate-20271208.pdf
